title: Attention cold-start recovery policy and profiling harness
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: We see intermittent high-latency and OOM spikes during warmup (cold-start) for certain model shapes when FlashAttention v3 kernels are selected. These incidents correlate with rapid kernel handoffs during the first 30s of traffic after a capacity scale or instance restart. Background: Current kernel selection picks v3 for performance; on some shapes/precisions the workspace and tiling heuristics cause allocation spikes that propagate into decode latencies and retries. Goal: Build a deterministic recovery policy plus a lightweight profiling harness to (1) detect bad cold-start kernel selections quickly, (2) fallback safely to a stable kernel variant with minimal request impact, and (3) produce reproducible telemetry for postmortem and autotune rules. Scope: - Implement a policy manager that monitors first-N requests and enforces conservative kernel selection if error/latency thresholds are exceeded. - Add an in-band micro-profiling harness that samples workspace allocations, kernel choice, and decode latency for the initial 200 requests per instance. - Rollout a canary job to validate behavior on Dedicated and Hosted fleets. Out-of-scope: full rework of kernel heuristics or global autoscaler behavior (this is a mitigation and observability improvement).
acceptance_criteria: Policy triggers within 20s of instance start when 25% of sampled requests exceed 2x baseline latency.
Fallback to alternative kernel variant completes within 150ms for subsequent requests without causing client-level errors.
Profiling harness emits a compact telemetry payload for first 200 requests with kernel tag, workspace bytes, and per-stage latency to Datadog/OTLP.
Automated smoke canary (1000 requests over 10 minutes) shows reduced spike frequency by >= 60% in canary fleet vs control.
Playbook and rollback steps documented and verified by SRE on staging.

telemetry_queries: OTLP: /rt/attn/profiler.first200 - compact payloads for offline analysis
testing_notes: Unit tests cover policy state transitions (STARTING -> MONITOR -> CONSERVATIVE -> NORMAL).
Synthetic replay harness runs 3 shape profiles (short, mixed, long) at q8/q4 and records kernel decisions.
Load test includes restart storms (30 restarts across 10 minutes) to validate no cascading failures.
rollback_plan: Disable policy via feature flag and revert PRs if canary shows regression. Emergency disable: flip runtime config key runtime.attn.coldstart.enabled=false; SRE to redeploy fleet nodes if needed.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Policy false-positive causing conservative selection for healthy workloads. Mitigation: short probation window and incremental cooldown with sticky decay.
Risk: Telemetry volume spike. Mitigation: sample and compact payloads; cap to 200 initial events per instance.
Risk: Interaction with autoscaler causing warmup churn. Mitigation: coordinate with autoscaling team and add a cooldown label to temp instances.
next_steps: Complete integration tests for fallback transition and measure 95th percentile additional latency.
Run Dedicated canary on 2025-03-04 and capture baseline/control telemetry.
If canary passes, schedule staged rollout to Hosted (region us-east-1) with 1% -> 10% -> 100% ramps.
